slice: P2 AC1027 consumed-style MLINE 2-to-3 append with cap-suppression flags
scope: Permit a selected AC1027 direct consumed-style append from two MLINESTYLE elements to three when source MLINE group-71 flags are 5, 9 or 13. Preserve the open/cap-suppression flags while adding the new per-vertex segment and recomputing group-41 parameters.

specEvidence.group41: Element parameters describe per-element segment intersections, starts and cuts. Cap suppression is carried separately in group 71.
specEvidence.interpretation: The selected append adds per-element segment parameters while preserving the documented group-71 cap state. Native cap rendering is not independently verified.

contract.admission: AC1027 only, direct edit of a source-bound consumed style with exactly two original elements and a three-element target. MLINE group-71 values 1, 5, 9 and 13 are admitted for this packet; 5/9/13 suppress start/end/both caps. Closed value 3 and unknown-bit value 17 refuse. The MLINESTYLE flags remain 2, and the existing source elements remain unchanged and ordered.
contract.projection: The target appends a third element at offset -1.25. Both source consumers (one ENTITIES, one BLOCKS) retain their positions, vertex directions, miters and group-71 flags. Each receives a third segment tuple with group 74 count 2, group 41 values recalculated from target offsets, and group 75 count 0; the target style has three elements and group 340 remains bound to the edited source style.
contract.outputAndReadback: Twelve positive combinations cover flags 5, 9 and 13 across ASCII/binary input and output. Physical output checks target style count/flags/offsets; both consumers' group 71, 340, 73, 74, 75 and exact group-41 parameter arrays; and unchanged vertex geometry. A fresh typed readback checks the three-element style, references, flags, vertices, miters and parameters.
contract.failureAndRetry: Closed and unknown group-71 profiles each refuse for both output encodings while preserving a destination sentinel and caller state; corrected flags-13 sources then succeed through the same writer. A late consumer-parameter mutation refuses atomically for both output encodings and succeeds on the same adapter after restoring caller state.
contract.compatibility: The new nondefault-cap admission is restricted to the AC1027 direct consumed-style 2-to-3 append. Other append counts, direct offset edits, removals, retarget appends, other versions and native cap appearance remain outside this receipt. No drawing fixture was committed; sources are generated in temporary directories.

sourceBindings.fixtureRecipe: The extended recipe in tests/dxf_fixture_tests.cpp generates the selected MLINESTYLE and MLINE source records at runtime; output proof inspects physical records and freshly imports the serialized output.

focusedBuild.summary: The final converter and fixture-test sources are built; the second command rebuilt the fixture test after its final output assertion was added.

focusedSelectors.summary: 4/4 passed in 1.46s; includes 12 positive cap profiles, 4 closed/unknown refusals with corrected-source retry, and 2 late-mutation refusals with same-adapter retry.
4/4 passed in 54.92s, including the shared projection helper's angle, retarget append/removal and consumed-style removal regressions.

validation.asan: NOT_RUN; this slice adds no new allocation, ownership, lifetime, bounds or handle path.

limitations: Only AC1027 direct consumed-style append from two elements to three is covered.
Group-71 flags are preserved and read back, but native cap appearance and rendered geometry are not qualified.
Other append counts, direct edits, removals, retarget routes, versions, document closure and support claims remain outside this receipt.
